headline: Engine deliveries improving; FY28, a likely inflection point for Tejas delivery

highlights: During the quarter, DAC accorded AoN in Sep’26 to proposals of ~INR 1.1trn, which include the ALH; potentially next on the anvil with expected OI worth INR 1tn.
Revenue beat; margin weighed by mix HAL's Q2FY27 EBITDA of INR 17.4bn grew 11.6% YoY/14% QoQ, ahead of our estimates.

Source: SES ESG, I-sec research Previous Reports 13-08-2026: Q1FY27 results review 17-05-2026: Q4FY26 results review Hindustan Aeronautics | Results Update | 13 November 2026 India | Institutional Equity Research 2 Order pipeline remains strong HAL's order book stood at INR 2.55tn at end-FY26, dominated by manufacturing (INR 2.2trn), with ~INR 300bn in RoH/spares.
The inflow pipeline continues to build as the DAC accorded AoN in Sep’26 to proposals of ~INR 1.1trn, which includes the ALH; thus, conversion of the 143 ALH order is a key near-term inflow.
valuation: As engine stockpiles improve delivery visibility, we raise our target multiple to 36x FY28E EPS (from 35x) and revise our TP to INR 5,925 (from INR 5,760).
We maintain our FY28E EPS and raise our target multiple to 36x (from 35x), factoring in better delivery visibility.
